stage: exploratory mechanism diagnostic, not calibrated or final validation
backbone: frozen ReF-LDM author weights and compatibility patch
perturbations: four leave-one-reference-out runs per input; same seed, order of retained references unchanged
risk_feature: mean RGB pixel standard deviation across the all-reference and four leave-one-out native outputs, normalized to 0..1
candidate_controls: preserve highest reference-disagreement quarter of masked pixels
preserve highest edit-magnitude quarter of masked pixels
coverage: rank exactly ceil(0.25 * mask pixels) for preservation; stable flat-index tie break; both gates edit identical area
calibration: none; no probability interpretation or learned threshold
evaluation: all existing independent metrics on candidate images; per-identity risk AUC against per-pixel increase in absolute reconstruction error relative to observation; pixel AUC is descriptive, not a significance test
target_access: clean targets and gallery are evaluator-only; never used for risk features or gating
decision: reference disagreement must add value beyond edit magnitude and unchanged-input controls before any fresh-identity calibration study; four observed identities cannot establish generalization
failures: retain all; no reference replacement or output selection based on quality
